title: Render daemon-stated no-terminal pairing truth in Control Room
description: Consumer of task-5d982842645f4b2996396c67867abeec. Admit the exact operatorChannel field from the daemon pair/request response. When false, return a non-authoritative unavailable state that carries neither requestId nor confirmationLabel and render an honest restart instruction in the daemon Cordum app; when true, preserve the existing pending/claim flow.
definitionOfDone: VERIFY-OR-BLOCK: at delivered HEAD, prove the real daemon `/session/pair/request` success response carries operatorChannel from actual operatorInput presence (task-5d982842645f4b2996396c67867abeec); if absent, report blocked because the UI may not guess terminal availability.

live-handshake admits exactly confirmationLabel/ok/operatorChannel/requestId; true returns the existing AWAITING_OPERATOR pending object, while false returns a frozen OPERATOR_CHANNEL_UNAVAILABLE state with no claim function, confirmation label, or request id.

CordumApp renders exactly `Moe was started without a terminal it can listen on. Stop it and run pnpm start from a terminal window, then reload this page.` for the unavailable state, with no pairing label output and no `I entered this label` action.

The operatorChannel true path still renders PairingConfirmation and claims exactly as before; malformed/missing/wrong-type operatorChannel refuses at the existing LIVE_PAIRING_REFUSED client layer rather than defaulting true.

Tests pin both exact state key rosters and browser-visible sentences, assert the false response's label/request id never reaches renderable/stringified state, and mutation drills defaulting false→true or rendering the label red the named assertions.
Control-room typecheck and focused/full tests run standalone with exit 0 and nonzero counts; path-attributed broad red adds no failure on the four owned paths.
taskRails: Own only apps/control-room/src/live/live-handshake.ts, live-handshake.test.ts, v2/cordum-app.tsx, and v2/cordum-app.test.tsx.
Do not edit PairingConfirmation or its current dirty/untracked usability WIP; the unavailable branch must bypass that component entirely.
operatorChannel is admitted only from the daemon response. Do not infer it from scope, browser APIs, a failed claim, or the presence of a label.
reopenReason: Superseded before planning: an additive response-header protocol avoids breaking the exact-key browser client between slices.
